scripts.build: pnpm config:sync && pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && pnpm --filter @share/web build && pnpm --filter @share/api-cloudflare build
scripts.dev: pnpm config:sync && pnpm --filter @share/web build && pnpm --parallel --filter @share/api-cloudflare --filter @share/web dev
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: node scripts/config.mjs sync --production && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @share/api-cloudflare run deploy
